title: Stateful DHCPv6 Address Assignment
summary: Configure and verify a Cisco router as a Stateful DHCPv6 server and examine ICMPv6 Router Advertisement Managed configuration flags, client lease bindings, and end-to-end IPv6 routing.
learning_objectives: Differentiate between SLAAC, Stateless DHCPv6, and Stateful DHCPv6 address assignment methods
Configure a Cisco IOS router as a Stateful DHCPv6 server with global unicast address pools, DNS server addresses, and domain search lists
Modify ICMPv6 Router Advertisement flags using the managed-config-flag and no-autoconfig directives
Configure end-host PC clients to request IPv6 addresses dynamically via Stateful DHCPv6
Inspect active DHCPv6 client bindings and DUID database entries on Cisco IOS using verification commands
Validate end-to-end dual-router IPv6 packet routing and reachability from dynamically configured client hosts

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise IPv6 services curriculum guide aligned with Cisco CCNA exam topic 4.4 (Configure and verify DHCP client and relay) and IPv6 stateful address assignment fundamentals
